claims.text: MultiLLM-Chatbot is a RAG-based benchmarking framework designed to evaluate LLMs across five specific domains: Agriculture, Biology, Economics, Internet of Things, and Medical.
LLAMA-3.3-70B is the overall best-performing model among the five tested LLMs across all five evaluated domains.

evidence.description: Experimental results show LLAMA-3.3-70B as the overall best-performing model, leading in all 5 domains.

methodologies.name: MultiLLM-Chatbot Evaluation Framework
methodologies.description: A modular RAG-based benchmarking framework evaluating LLM responses across four dimensions using document retrieval and automated scoring.
conditions: Evaluated 5 models: GPT-4-Turbo, CLAUDE-3.7-Sonnet, LLAMA-3.3-70B, DeepSeek-R1-Zero, Gemini-2.0-Flash
4 metric dimensions: cosine similarity, VADER sentiment analysis, TF-IDF scoring, and NER-based hallucination detection

limitations.text: Challenges such as semantic similarity, bias/sentiment, and hallucinations persist in domain-specific applications.
Current LLM benchmarking procedures contain gaps in comprehensive cross-domain and multi-metric evaluation.
